title: Workspace settings
description: Manage the general settings of your workspace
startHereBody: Finish setup first. Language and workspace danger-zone actions stay below.
languageSectionHint: Personal preference for your account — applied immediately.
platformSupportBody: Bokito operators can enter this workspace for support and technical work. Turn this off to keep it private to your team.
deleteWorkspaceDescription: This action cannot be undone. All data will be permanently deleted.
deleteDialogPrompt: Type the workspace name "{{name}}" to confirm:
languageSaveError: Language changed for this session, but could not be saved to your account.

brandingPage.title: Branding
brandingPage.subtitle: Manage your workspace branding, including name, logo and brand color.
brandingPage.name: Name
brandingPage.logoHint: Shown in the portal and widgets. PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG (SVG is automatically optimized for upload).
brandingPage.faviconHint: Pictogram for your portal (tab + rail) and the chat widget. Without one the widget falls back to Bokito. PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG.
brandingPage.brandColorHint: Pick one color. The product keeps the hue and tones it into a modern palette so buttons, nav and highlights stay fresh in light and dark.
brandingPage.subdomainHint: Where people can reach your workspace.
brandingPage.subdomainInvalid: Use 3-63 characters: a-z, 0-9 and "-" (cannot start or end with "-").
brandingPage.chatWidgetDescription: Customize colors, typography and behavior of the chat widget.
brandingPage.noWorkspace: No active workspace or session found.
brandingPage.invalidFileType: Invalid file type. Use PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG.
